utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon to everyone. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case for today's hearing.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case Number IT-92-4-A, The Prosecutor versus Dragan Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Nikolic, can you hear and follow the proceedings? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I can hear clearly, and I can understand everything.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. You may be seated. Would the parties be kind enough to identify themselves, beginning with the representative of the OTP, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Appearing for the Prosecution is Norman Farrell, and with me is the case manager, Mr. Kebba Khan. May I just offer my apologies to the Court, the staff and counsel and the appellant for being late.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I turn now the representative of the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MS. RADOSAVLJEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. For the accused, Tanja Radosavljevic, co-counsel. The Defence would like to excuse Mr. Howard Morrison, the lead counsel. He isn't present due to an ongoing trial in front of the other Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Regarding the purpose of the Status Conference, in conformity with the provisions of Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, a Status Conference needs to be held within 120 days following the filing of the appeals document. Awaiting a ruling on the appeal, an opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto. In the present case, a notice of appeal has been filed by Mr. Dragan Nikolic on the 16th of January 2004. This is, therefore, the first Status Conference held in the appeals proceedings in this case. This Status Conference has as its objective to allow the appellant to raise any concerns he may have in connection with the conditions of detention or his state of mental and physical health. Mr. Nikolic, or his counsel Madam Radosavljevic, would you like to convey to the Chamber any concerns that you may have of this kind.

utterances.speaker: MS. RADOSAVLJEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Actually, the Defence would like to inform Your Honour about the health condition of Mr. Nikolic and would like to move, Your Honour, to do this in closed or private session, just to inform the Chamber on the health status of our client.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Will you sit down, please. Is your preference for a closed session or a private session? Which one?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Let us have a private session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we are in public session now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I will resume for the sake of the public hearing. Regarding the progress made in the appeals proceeding, as you know, the ultimate objective of the Status Conference is to inform the appellant of the progress made with the appeals proceedings. In this connection, I wish to remind you, Mr. Nikolic, that the filing of your appellant brief is expected not later than 30 days following the receival by you of a B/C/S translation of the sentencing judgement. The Registrar has notified the Chamber that the B/C/S translation should be available on the 1st of June 2004. In the absence of any filings by the parties, I have no questions to address to the parties at this stage of the proceedings. I would, however, like to ask the parties whether they have on their part any observations to make or questions that they wish to address. Mr. Farrell.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: No, thank you very much, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. As there are no other matters to address or any other remarks to be made, the present Status Conference can now be adjourned. And it is so decided.
